mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.2% (a near-zero rate environment), it signals an aggressive monetary policy stance that boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.2, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which is associated with rising corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) both rise by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it indicates a housing market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both rise by more than 0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC for the regime signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals robust economic activity, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO has increased over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year inflation rate below 1.5% (as measured by CPIAUCSL) indicates a stable price environment that supports corporate profit growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY rate < 1.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a central bank's response to economic weakness, which initially boosts equity valuations due to expectations of policy support, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy response to economic weakness
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS declining and CPIAUCSL rising fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightness regime (defined by unemployment rate below 5% and month-over-month employment growth above 0.5%), corporate hiring and wage growth support consumer spending and earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC for the regime signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
